description: HTTP request + content extraction · default: extracted body, non-2xx is an error. response.accept opts into exact named statuses as {status_code, url, body}; no response headers. SSRF-defended.

facts: without a mode the whole page comes back as markdown text, its relative links kept relative
mode article returns the main content as markdown, without navigation or footer, its links made absolute
mode text returns the page's text without markup
mode selector returns the matched element's HTML as text
mode metadata returns an object with the page's title and description
mode links returns the page's link targets as absolute URLs in page order, no anchor text
mode raw returns the body text unchanged
mode jq runs its expression over the decoded JSON body
a JSON body read without a mode comes back as markdown text with escaped brackets, which fromjson cannot decode: read an API with mode jq (or raw, then fromjson)
mode raw returns the body's exact text, which fromjson decodes

mode feed returns {title, link, description, items: [{id, title, link, summary, published, categories}]}, absent fields omitted; published is RFC 3339 in UTC with +00:00 (an RSS pubDate in +0400 included)

an Atom entry dated only by <updated> reports it as `updated` (RFC 3339 in UTC, +00:00) and no `published` (from engine 501e2fd29; earlier engines report no date): a date filter reads `published // updated`
an entry published then revised keeps both, `published` and `updated`; a revision date equal to the publication date is not repeated
mode sitemap returns [{loc, lastmod?}] in document order
a status outside 2xx fails the task: fails NIKA-BUILTIN-FETCH-001
response.accept turns an accepted status into {status_code, url, body}
